# Infinite Red — account brief

## Who

Infinite Red is a consultancy specializing in React Native app design and development ([source](https://infinitered.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists the company as Infinite Red at infinitered.com ([source](https://github.com/infinitered)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is present in `infinitered/ignite` ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/eas.json)).
- `package.json` in `infinitered/ignite` lists react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/package.json)).
- `infinitered/ignite` has CI workflows ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 150 public repos and 2100 followers ([source](https://github.com/infinitered)).
- `infinitered/ignite` was last pushed 2026-08-11 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite)).
- Infinite Red links a careers page from its homepage ([source](https://infinitered.com/careers)).

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@infinitered-maintainer-1), top contributor to `infinitered/ignite` with 310 commits ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company "Infinite Red", location "Remote", website https://infinitered.com, and bio "Mobile engineer at Infinite Red. Maintains Ignite (Expo / React Native)." ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-1)).
- Maintainer Two (@infinitered-maintainer-2), top contributor to `infinitered/ignite` with 188 commits ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company "Infinite Red", location "New York, NY", website https://infinitered.com, and bio "React Native developer on the Infinite Red mobile team. EAS builds and releases for Ignite." ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-2)).
- Maintainer Three (@infinitered-maintainer-3), top contributor to `infinitered/ignite` with 97 commits ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company "Infinite Red", location "San Francisco, CA", website https://infinitered.com, and bio "Engineer at Infinite Red. Mostly Ignite, sometimes the API." ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-3)).

## Why now

`infinitered/ignite` was last pushed 2026-08-11 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite)) and runs react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/package.json)). The evidence contains no store update cadence or review volume, so recency here is repo activity only.

## Suggested opener

Maintainer Two — your profile says you handle EAS builds and releases for Ignite ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-2)), and you have 188 commits to the repo ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-2)). Ignite carries an `eas.json` ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/eas.json)) alongside CI workflows in `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/tree/main/.github/workflows)). How is the split between those workflows and EAS working for you on Ignite releases today?
